title: Nifty reclaims 25,000 as Sensex jumps 1,718 points, shrugging off a global tech rout; best week in over five years
short: Nifty reclaims 25,000 on 7th straight gain; Sensex +1,718
dek: Banks and a handful of heavyweights lifted the benchmarks for a seventh straight day even as Wall Street and Asian tech stocks crashed. But most shares fell. The rupee gained 52 paise.
